source: MeasuredCADmodel.stp, laser-scanned as-built model, sliced with gmsh/OCC
method: STEP imported through gmsh OCC, surfaces meshed at 2-4 mm, nodes sliced in +/-1.5 mm slabs, each slab rotated onto its own chord line (LE = point farthest from the TE)
validation: chords match the design report Table 1 to 0.15 % (532.2 vs 533 at y=600, 464.7 vs 465 at y=1200); the section matches the 36 pressure taps at y=600 to a median of 0.374 % of chord, which is the same order as the 2-4 mm surface sampling
